Deep Intelligence shipped as one product on Oct 19: daily ranked accounts and contacts with fit score and dated signal, Buying Group (beta), Website Visits (beta, company-level, Pro+), all also via API and MCP. Daily list included in plans; Buying Group reveals use credits.

Named a flagship data partner for Salesforce's Hunter outbound agent (Oct 15): data 'built into Hunter' with no separate login. Also an n8n GTM.AI node (Oct 12) and the Workbounce knowledge layer (Oct 14).

AI spend controls (Oct 15): default credit cap up to 50% above monthly credits, self-serve seat-to-credit swaps mid-contract, credit packs or Pay-as-You-Go. Prospecting Agent stays at $1 per recommended lead.
Gong Enrich (Sep 30, Celebrate '26): native enrichment with launch partners Apollo, LeadIQ, Lusha, ZoomInfo and others; LinkedIn not listed. Also Agent Builder and Deep Mode.
Promoted the Messaging OS beta on X (Oct 19): 'uses buying signals to help decide who to reach, when, and on which channel'. Still a waitlist.
Onboarding email (Oct 18) gives a sample prompt that verifies attendee titles 'using LinkedIn and verified website confirmation'.

Release notes list an Oct 21 entry: Value App (sourced pipeline, estimated seller time saved), with Agents split into Automations and Outbound. Oct 14: workflow suggestions learned from repeated chat requests.
October release (rolling out Oct 8 to 27): Org Context that grounds every agent, Omni in Slack channels, Revenue Agent reporting (Amplify package).
Homepage case-study block now leads with MCP use: 'How Planful runs ABM from Claude with the UserGems MCP'. Pricing page unchanged.
Open roles 105 to 104 (Greenhouse). New: Manager, GTM Customer Success; Senior GTM Enablement Manager. No new AI titles.
No change: no Sales Navigator release since Sep 22. Core $119.99/mo and Advanced $159.99/mo list prices unchanged (plans page updated Sep 27, 2026). No public MCP.
